description: This file defines the Map.Keyboard handler for keyboard interactions in the Leaflet mapping library, including panning and zooming via keyboard keys.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: A handler extending Leaflet's Handler to enable keyboard navigation (panning and zooming) on the map.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Keyboard handler with the map instance and sets pan and zoom delta options.

methods.name: addHooks
methods.description: Adds event listeners to enable keyboard interaction and focus management.

methods.name: removeHooks
methods.description: Removes event listeners related to keyboard interaction.

methods.name: _onMouseDown
methods.description: Focuses the map container when mouse is pressed inside, ensuring keyboard events are captured.

methods.name: _onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, sets internal state, and fires 'focus' on the map.

methods.name: _onBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, updates internal state, and fires 'blur' on the map.

methods.name: _setPanDelta
methods.description: Configures pan offsets for arrow keys based on the pan delta.

methods.name: _setZoomDelta
methods.description: Configures zoom step sizes for zoom in/out keys.

methods.name: _addHooks
methods.description: Attaches keydown event listener for handling keyboard navigation.

methods.name: _onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events to perform panning or zooming based on pressed keys.
